title.en: Allocating P20m Annually of the Urban Livelihood Financing Program of the Technology Resource Center for the Livelihood Development Program of the National Housing Authority
title.orig: Allocating P20m Annually of the Urban Livelihood Financing Program of the Technology Resource Center for the Livelihood Development Program of the National Housing Authority

text.en:
The National Housing Authority and Technology Resource Center shall jointly implement a livelihood
development program in all NHA projects for marginal and low-income families.

The Technology Resource Center shall allocate P20 M annually from its Urban Livelihood Financing
Program to support the above mentioned livelihood development program in NHA projects. For this purpose,
the National Housing Authority shall submit to the Technology Research Center at the beginning of the
budget year a program identifying candidate projects for the given year.

The Technology Resource Center and the National Housing Authority shall involve the implementing
rules and regulations for their joint livelihood development program.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
